meta.title: 50단어 내외의 긴 기출 문장
meta.note: 대표 원문 Q01~Q02를 source-aligned 상태로 유지하며, Q02-2의 축약·변형 문장을 원문 전체로 복원하고 모바일 부담이 큰 Q01 관계사절 범위 문항은 동일 원문 기반 선택형으로 조정함.

items.sentence: The recovery of appetite or the motivation to eat is apparent to anyone who has consumed a large meal and is quite full, and does not require additional energy or nutrients to meet their daily needs, but decides to consume additional calories after seeing the dessert cart.
items.prompt: who가 이끄는 관계사절 안에서 and와 but으로 연결되는 동사 묶음으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: has consumed / is / does not require / decides
is apparent / has consumed / meet / seeing
items.answer: has consumed / is / does not require / decides
items.explanation: who부터 문장 끝까지가 anyone을 수식하며 관계사절 내부에서 has consumed, is, does not require, decides가 and와 but으로 연결됩니다.
items.memory: 50단어 안팎 문장은 먼저 주절을 남기고 긴 관계사절 내부의 병렬을 별도로 추적

items.sentence: The recovery of appetite or the motivation to eat is apparent to anyone who has consumed a large meal and is quite full, and does not require additional energy or nutrients to meet their daily needs, but decides to consume additional calories after seeing the dessert cart.
items.prompt: anyone을 수식하는 관계사절의 범위로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: who has consumed a large meal까지만
items.explanation: who부터 문장 끝까지가 선행사 anyone을 수식합니다. 긴 범위를 모바일에서 직접 드래그하지 않고 구조 범위를 판단하도록 조정했습니다.

items.sentence: In the context of SNS, media literacy has been argued to be especially important in order to make the users aware of their rights when using SNS tools, and also help them not only acquire or reinforce human rights values but also develop the behavior necessary to respect other people's rights and freedoms.
items.prompt: in order to 이하에서 and also로 병렬 연결되는 두 동사원형을 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: in order to make ...와 (in order to) help ...가 and also로 병렬 연결됩니다.

items.sentence: In the context of SNS, media literacy has been argued to be especially important in order to make the users aware of their rights when using SNS tools, and also help them not only acquire or reinforce human rights values but also develop the behavior necessary to respect other people's rights and freedoms.
items.prompt: help의 목적격보어에서 not only A but also B로 연결되는 핵심 동사로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 원문 그대로 not only 뒤의 acquire or reinforce와 but also 뒤의 develop이 병렬입니다.
